text:
Alex: quick async standup — finished the routing-weight migration PR, pushed canary to us-west with 5% traffic. saw slight bump in 429s around 1200ms tail lat, digging in
Maria: nice. can you drop the PR link? I wanted to review the policy change for auth header passthrough
Alex: https://github.com/redwood-inference/gateway/pull/4821 — main change is weight config -> ranges and added 'prefer-stable' flag
Sam: skimmed the code, one nit on the validator — range parsing doesn't reject empty ranges, maybe break early
Jordan: FYI the quota service had a deploy during the canary window, could be noise. deploy-bot shows rollout at 1719001300
deploy-bot: rollout started: quota-service v2.14.3 -> success on canary nodes (3/3), monitoring enabled
Natalie: blocker: the staging load generator is still using old routing config, so I can't reproduce locally. I'll re-run after staging sync
Alex: noted. for now i'll flip canary back to 0% at 1719001400 if 429s persist. would like an ✅ from Sam on validator fix before reapplying
Sam: can do today. pushing a tiny patch to fail-fast on invalid ranges, will include unit test. PR soon
Maria: also a docs heads-up — the new 'prefer-stable' semantic means we sometimes route to smaller but higher-SLO pools. add to ops runbook
Jordan: ops note — if prefer-stable causes capacity pressure, routing will fallback to cost-tier after 200ms. Is that threshold ok?
Alex: 200ms was chosen empirically for prod mix, open to tuning. add a metric for fallback-rate and alert if >0.5% over 5m
Natalie: re: reproducer — I'll sync staging config in 15m and run a 30m ramp. posting results here
Maria: tiny QA ask — can we include the exact header set we preserve in the docs snippet? saves back-and-forth
Alex: yes will add snippet. example: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Forwarded-For: 1.2.3.4" https://gateway.internal/route```
Sam: thanks. pinging @Alex for code review when PR is ready. also seeing a flaky test in ci: TestRouteWeights::handles-edge-cases, I'll fix in the same branch
Alex: perfect. owners: Alex (routing), Sam (validator), Maria (docs), Natalie (staging repro). I'll update the canary once Sam's patch merges
Maria: no blockers from docs side. will prep runbook snippet and add an example alert rule for fallback-rate
Jordan: quick logistics — can someone own rollback if we hit >1% 5xxs? I'll be on-call in 2 hours but prefer someone nearby to trigger
Alex: I'll own rollback for the next 2 hours. if I don't respond, @Jordan take over
deploy-bot: canary adjusted: routing canary -> 0% at 1719001405 (requested by Alex)
Natalie: staging sync done, starting load ramp now. will report back in ~35m
Sam: PR opened: #4830 — validator: fail on empty range + test added
Alex: reviewing now. thanks team — feel free to drop quick comments here instead of another meeting :thumbsup:
